wrong.why: Verse 10:32 continues the sons of Harim list begun at 10:31, and Hashum is named only at 10:33, so Shemariah is not said to be a descendant of hashum-2 (a different man, NEH 8:4); row 102665 already records him under harim-2.
Machnadebai is in the list of Bani's descendants at 10:34-42, which is bani-4, not the Gadite Bani of 2SA 23:36; bani-4 is already recorded in row 101016, so this row can simply be dropped.

Verse 10:38 names Bani, Binnui and Shimei side by side as members of one family list, so the text does not say Shimei is a descendant of bani-5 (his brother in that list); row 106713 already gives bani-4.
Verse 10:36 is a flat list ('Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib') with no parentage between Vaniah and Meremoth; the descent from bani-4 in row 101274 is the one the list supports.
Verse 10:42 is a flat list ('Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph') with no parentage between Amariah and Joseph; row 100578 already records Joseph under bani-4, which the list supports.

missing.why: Verse 10:23 says 'Also of the Levites' and names Eliezer among them, and the five other Levites named there are each recorded descendant-of levi, but no row exists for eliezer-11.

note: Owner rows were not judged wrong; maaseiah-6 (owner-ruled under harim-3 for the 10:21 Maaseiah) also carries the 10:18 priest, and eliezer-7/eliezer-10 and jarib/jarib-2 are each recorded for the single 10:18 man, so the site holds two records for one person there. Lists headed 'of the sons of X' are recorded descendant-of throughout by convention, so I did not list son-of as missing, and 'the same is Kelita' (10:23) is an identity rather than a family type, so it is not listed.
